        return np.sum((y - pred)**2) + alpha * np.sum(b**2)
    res = minimize(loss, np.zeros(9), bounds=[(None, None)]*8 + [(0, None)])
    c, b, a = res.x[0], res.x[1:8], res.x[8]
    # Optimal dx = -b / (2*a) projected onto sum(dx)=0
    b_proj = b - np.mean(b)
    dx_opt = -b_proj / (2 * a) if a > 0 else np.zeros(7)
    x_opt = x5 + dx_opt
    print(f"alpha={alpha}: c={c:.4f}, a={a:.1f}")
    for col, v5, vo, bi in zip(cols, x5, x_opt, b_proj):
        print(f"  {col:22s}: x5={v5:.4f} -> x_opt={vo:.4f} (grad={bi:+.2f})")
"}
